name: ROUNDHOUSE SQUAT KICKS
introduce:
Stand with feet shoulder width apart. Put your arms in front of your chest to keep your balance. 

Then do a squat, and when you come up, kick your left leg to the side. Repeat the exercise and then switch to the right leg. 

Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up. Your knees should be extended in line with your toes.

It's a great exercise for the quadriceps and gluteus maximus.

tips.text: Your knees should be in line with your toes.
Your knees should not go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
To increase the difficulty, raise your leg as high as you can when you go up.
If it's too hard for you, don't kick your leg too high when you go up.
This exercise is going to target all the muscles of your lower body.
